status: Registered after individual learned and gap experiments, before any composed candidate scores
hypothesis: Duration-weighted training improves ownership on every natural development game, while the independent gap mechanism corrects a complementary dead-ball error. Their composition may yield a sufficient gain without changing thresholds or fitting additional parameters.
fixed_composition: Use the already fitted weighted3000-step neural checkpoint. Preserve50/50 inherited/new H/A fusion and observed-frame D fusion. In missing-ball frames only, D=.75 new-neural D+.25 already fitted activity-expert D. Original decoder or exactly the previously registered .4s/4.5 H/A decoder.
data: Same ten development games and two scenarios/references. No six bridges, old final or target labels. No refitting, no interpolation, no new thresholds or data after viewing scores.
gates: Unchanged +.02 mean Spell,8/10 positive games,worst>=-.02,macro>=-.002 in each scenario and reference.
selection: If eligible, select largest minimum scenario gain; original decoder on tie. Freeze one choice before supplementary checks; failed supplementary checks do not trigger a weight/threshold search.

supplement_if_pass.meaning: In-sample cross-provider regression only, not unseen generalization
supplement_if_pass.scenarios: Original matched_seed0 and label_blind_seed1; SkillCorner natural_detected and label_blind_seed7
supplement_if_pass.guards: Paired against frozen parent, each provider/scenario mean Spell>=-.005, mean macro>=-.002, each game Spell>=-.02. Then full inference contracts, official validator and repeatable artifact generation; no organizer submission.

limitations: Adaptive development. Prior six-game/old-final scores cannot be attributed to this changed model. All failed earlier candidates and unchanged gates remain visible.
